cases.name: inventory-shares-machine-files
cases.scenario: Generated English Markdown and JSON do not create additional canonical sources.

cases.scenario: Delete only the isolated target, then validate.

cases.name: stale-marker-fails
cases.scenario: Valid marker format with an outdated source SHA cannot pass.

cases.name: untranslated-body-fails
cases.scenario: Copy the complete Chinese canonical body under an otherwise valid marker.

cases.name: english-suffix-does-not-bypass
cases.scenario: A canonical *.en.md file containing a Chinese heading is rejected.

cases.name: readme-valid-marker-truncation-fails
cases.scenario: A README companion with a valid source marker but missing a section and code must fail.

cases.name: readme-source-drift-fails

cases.name: readme-english-drift-fails
cases.scenario: Finalize a README pair, then change English prose without changing heading levels.

cases.name: manifest-missing-fails
cases.scenario: CLI check requires a finalized manifest.

cases.name: manifest-duplicate-fails
cases.scenario: A duplicate recorded canonical source is rejected.

cases.name: windows-path-boundary-fails
cases.scenario: A real sibling file exists, but raw and encoded backslash traversal cannot validate it.

cases.name: rewrite-preserves-code-and-shared-data
cases.scenario: Markdown navigation changes to English; fenced and inline examples remain verbatim; JSON stays shared.

cases.name: encoded-filename-preserved
cases.scenario: Space and hash remain encoded inside a path during rewriting.

cases.name: escaped-mismatched-inline-link-fails
cases.scenario: Escaped backticks and unequal backtick runs cannot hide a real missing link.

cases.name: finalize-idempotent-and-cli-check-readonly
cases.scenario: Finalize twice in an isolated two-page fixture, preserve canonical/data hashes, then compare every fixture byte before and after the CLI check.

notes: All paragraphs, both command blocks, versions/dates, 15/8 skill counts, SI/SPL and evidence boundaries, default budget, rights and NOT RUN qualifications were fully compared.
readme_audit.recheck_note: Fully re-read finalized README companion. Changes from initial reviewed bytes are generated notice/anchors and English Markdown navigation; command/code and semantic body remain faithful.

limits: This reviews the frozen validator plus a full README translation pair; it does not verify all translated sentences.
Remote URL availability and anchor identity are not checked.
No production sources or translations were mutated. Isolated fixtures and these reports are the only reviewer outputs.
The English corpus gate is still standalone at this snapshot; coordinator will integrate a read-only npm gate after interim manifest freeze.

findings.title: Nested image-link outer destination is omitted by link extraction and rewriting
findings.expected: MISSING_LOCAL_LINK for the outer missing.md destination
findings.observed: PASS with zero errors and warnings; existing inner image checked only
findings.resolution_note: Unsupported local nested-image outer destinations are explicitly rejected with UNSUPPORTED_LOCAL_LINK_SYNTAX. The validator does not pretend to rewrite all CommonMark forms.

resolved_and_independently_rechecked: Unreviewed Chinese prose is a hard failure.
An .en.md filename cannot bypass Han-prose coverage checks.
Raw/decoded Windows separators and decoded absolute paths are rejected.
Escaped and unequal backtick runs do not suppress real navigation.
README companion uses complete provenance, section, fence, ID and relation checks.
Nested-image outer local destinations no longer silently pass; unsupported syntax is a hard failure.

integration.coordinator_plan: Hook a read-only npm English gate after the interim manifest freeze.

cli_readonly_evidence.name: finalize-idempotent-and-cli-check-readonly
cli_readonly_evidence.scenario: Finalize twice in an isolated two-page fixture, preserve canonical/data hashes, then compare every fixture byte before and after the CLI check.

independent_fixture_command: PowerShell literal heredoc containing the independent fixture suite piped to node --input-type=module; no source/test file written.
